content:
The parked session verified N-007 against the code and found two defects in decision 1 and two unticketed blockers in decision 5. All confirmed; N-007 is amended as follows and N-007 remains authoritative where not amended.

1a. FULLY-PRUNED SOURCE / PERMANENT WEDGE (dominance.ts:178-181 incomparable on one-sided key; store.ts throws; every later candidate lacks the key too). Neither of the session's two alternatives is adopted as-is: a single global watermark key surrenders exactly the per-source regression protection the gate exists for (codex vanishing while claude advances would publish), and carrying a gone source at its last watermark makes the version claim data the payload does not contain. Adopted instead: THE KEY SET MAY SHRINK ONLY BY EXPLICIT ATTESTED RETIREMENT. publishSnapshot gains a retireSources option; dominance permits a missing key only when that key is named there. The service attests retirement only after verifying the INPUT side (the source's transcript location exists and is empty/pruned — legitimately quiet), never from mere absence in ccusage output. Unattested absence stays incomparable and fail-closed — but the exit from that state is now the service's verified attestation, not a manual full reset. Retirement is logged as its own outcome.

1b. EQUAL-WATERMARK NO-OP gets a named home: publishSnapshot returns a third status, {status:"unchanged"}, distinct from published and refused, produced when the candidate equals the live watermark. Telemetry that reported it as published would lie about freshness — the class of defect this whole arc is about.

2a. ccusageInvokedAt bookkeeping (session's note, adopted verbatim): the rename is an exact-key schema change to shipped T-010, so an old-field snapshot fails assertExactKeys and classifies to reset. Pre-release that is acceptable and is now WRITTEN DOWN in T-025 rather than discovered.

5a. Decision 5's two blockers are ticketed as T-025 (see ticket): ISS-064 generation-body invariants are a hard prerequisite of readGeneration ("full validation" does not exist to call yet), and AC 4's pinning needs a pin-request path through T-011's control socket because createPin requires the writer's authority — readers cannot pin and must not impersonate. T-011's scope now includes that path; T-013's AC 4 is annotated to consume it.

Runway consequence: /story auto T-025 T-011 T-013 T-012.
title: N-008: amendments to N-007 after the parked session's verified pushback
